title: No duplicate work across the pipeline
goal: From the listing to embed, no stage redoes or rewrites what has not changed: a row is written only when it differs, and a document is republished and re-read only when what the app reads of it changed. cf8ebae edited build.py and all 12,275 documents were rebuilt, republished and re-read for embed with 0 chunks changed (2026-11-18) (user).
for_whom: The nightly pipeline on ampere and the 1 GB Neon project it writes: less work each night and no table bloat from identical rewrites.

done_check.check: listing: a listed row is updated only when its data differs (no nightly rewrite of every row; last_seen, read by nothing, is no longer bumped).
build: a rebuilt document whose docs row or chunks come out identical leaves those rows untouched (no new row versions).
links: a relinked document whose citations come out identical leaves its mentions rows untouched.

publish decides a document changed from a hash of what it writes to kb for it (its kb.docs fields; its chunks' address, label, path, part and text hash; its links and their mention columns; its same_as), computed inside the database, not from the build's input fingerprint.
embed reads from R2 only the documents published since the last embed, not every document.
Tests: the same output with a different build fingerprint is not republished; a changed title, chunk text hash, link or citation is; identical build and link output writes no rows.
On ampere after it lands: one run switches publish's stored fingerprints to the new form; the next run with nothing new reports 0 to publish, 0 rows rewritten by listing, and embed reads 0 documents.
After publish commits, the kb tables are compacted (VACUUM FULL), so the old copies of republished documents do not sit in the files until the next publish; publish's output shows the size after it.

scenarios.steps: Nightly-style Dagster run on ampere after the switch, with no new documents listed.
scenarios.expect: listing rewrites 0 unchanged rows; publish to_publish 0; embed reads 0 documents; the database size does not grow.

out_of_scope: Recomputing fewer documents after a builder code edit (the build still recomputes every document to find out what changed; ampere CPU only, nothing written when identical).
fetch, extract and OCR (already keyed by file hash and tool version).
resolve's per-run recompute of links in SQL (seconds, no bloat: it truncates).

decisions.note: Widened from 'publish only documents whose output changed' to every stage (user: 'from the fetch and from the start we need to remove duplicate work').
The first publish after the change rewrites every document once more (the stored fingerprints change form); with cleanup (#84) it fits.

d8 added (user): after run cebb22bc's full republish the db rested at 743 MB, ~205 MB of it the old kb copies (kb.links 195 MB vs 97 compacted, kb.chunks 193 vs 96, kb.docs 22 vs 11), kept until the next publish's pre-write cleanup.
listings.last_seen has no reader (grep of etl and app), so it stops being bumped rather than moving to a side table.
